question: Which employees earn more than 150000?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE salary > 150000

question: List the products in the Furniture category from cheapest to most expensive.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Furniture' ORDER BY price ASC

question: How many customers live in Pune?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Pune'

question: Which products have fewer than 10 units in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 10

question: Show the employees hired in 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE YEAR(hire_date) = 2024

question: Who is the highest paid employee?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees)

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products)

question: What is the average salary in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name

question: How many orders were placed each year?
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date)

question: What is the total revenue from all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders

question: How many products are there in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Which city has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees were hired each year?
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(hire_date), COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY YEAR(hire_date)

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which product has sold the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue for each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: How many employees does each department have?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name

question: Which department has the most employees?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders have customers from Mumbai placed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Mumbai'

question: Which products were bought in order number 42?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 42

question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employees earn more than the average salary of their own department?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id)

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: Which departments have an average salary above the company-wide average salary?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING AVG(e.salary) > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)

question: Who is the highest paid employee in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id)

question: In 2025, which month had the highest total order amount? Give the month number.
gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(order_date) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in September 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

question: How many customers joined in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE YEAR(join_date) = 2025

question: What was the total order amount in the first quarter of 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: How many orders have been placed so far this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
